items.name: cc-theme
items.title: CodeCora theme bridge
items.description: Installs @codecora/tokens and points the shadcn-svelte variables at --cc-* tokens, so shadcn components follow data-theme, data-accent and data-density.

items.name: cc-login
items.title: Login form
items.description: Sign-in card with email, password, remember me, progress and error states.

items.name: cc-settings
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Profile, notifications and danger-zone tabs with one save button and a confirm dialog.

items.name: cc-dashboard-shell
items.title: Dashboard shell
items.description: AppShell with sidebar, mobile drawer and bottom bar, and a page header with actions.

items.name: cc-console-overview
items.title: Console overview
items.description: Developer console frame: sidebar with a user menu, a breadcrumb and search header, a title row, tabs and a page body.

items.name: cc-resource-detail
items.title: Resource detail
items.description: Detail page: back link, header with a split primary button, a grouped list with row menus, and a segmented tool list with search and a callout.

items.name: cc-status-panel
items.title: Status panel
items.description: Status card with a tinted icon, an action, a strip of labelled stats and a why / what-to-do panel; the tone sets the icon and tint.

items.name: cc-data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Searchable, filterable, sortable and paged table with row selection and a bulk action.
